quality_check.description: A clean vertical 9:16 object reference sheet showing the same worn maritime spyglass twice on a neutral light-gray background. The upper view is a near-side profile with a warm brown cylindrical barrel, aged golden-brass telescoping sections and joining bands, a broad brass objective rim with dark blue-black glass and painted highlights, and a smaller brass eyepiece. The lower view shows the same spyglass from a three-quarter eyepiece-facing angle.
